court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: City Civil Court, Greater Mumbai (Adoption Petition No.57/2022)
case_name: Parag Mahadev Jadhav And Others vs Nil
facts_of_case: The Appellants are parties to Adoption Petition No.57/2022. The minor child is in the custody of the Appellant No.2 and her husband, Appellant No.1. They proposed to adopt the child, and all concerned parties consented. The trial court allowed the petition and declared the Appellants as parents of the child.

legal_principles.principle: The welfare of the minor child is paramount.
legal_principles.held: All the concerned parties consented for adoption, since it was in the interest and welfare of the minor child.
applicable_acts_sections: Hindu Adoption and Maintenance Act, 1956 — Section 7
